<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Dismissal" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPN" name="MSPN" processRef="Process_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPO" name="MSPO" processRef="Process_MSPO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPN" name="MSPN process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MSPN" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPN_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendDismissal" name="Send dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPN_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPN_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MSPN" name="Dismissal sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPN_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MSPN" targetRef="SendTask_SendDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_MSPN"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPO" name="MSPO process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_DismissalReceived" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectDismissal" name="Reject dismissal of MSPN">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDismissal" name="Confirm dismissal of MSPN">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Dismissal rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_RejectDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_5" sourceRef="Task_RejectDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends a request or notice to another participant, and the receiving participant then acts on it (for example by reviewing it): Model the sending as a task performed by the sender, placed in the sender's pool or lane, and connect it by a sequence flow to the receiver's activity. Do not replace the sending action with a start event. A start event marks only the process's initiating node; if the sending is the first described action, place a plain start event before the sender's send task.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant sends a request or notice to another participant, and the receiving participant then acts on it (for example by reviewing it)

rules.instruction: When the description has an exclusive decision with two or more alternative branches that later continue to the same shared step, and at least one alternative branch ends in a request that awaits a reply before the shared step: Model the decision with an exclusive gateway. Give each alternative branch its own path. Join the alternative branches with an exclusive merge gateway placed before the shared step, so the shared step is entered once from whichever branch was taken. Do not connect the alternative branches directly to the shared step, and do not use a parallel join for them.
rules.situation: the description states that one of two mutually exclusive outcomes of a single decision occurs (joined by 'or'), and the branches for these outcomes are followed by a common end or later step

rules.instruction: When the description presents two or more mutually exclusive alternative activities, each of which by itself leads to the same next step or end event, so that either alternative is sufficient: Model an exclusive (XOR) gateway that routes the flow into one of the alternative activities, if the preceding point chooses between them. Connect each alternative activity to a single exclusive merge gateway, and connect that merge gateway to the shared next step or end event. Do not connect alternatives directly to the shared step or end event, and do not use a parallel gateway for alternatives that exclude each other.
rules.situation: the description states two alternative outcomes of the same actor joined by 'or', each of which by itself leads to the same end event or next step, so either outcome is sufficient
